objective: Use up to five short-horizon Satellite gap-fillers to monetize Core-idle/free capacity without turning them into a second main strategy. A stronger Core opportunity may reclaim a Satellite slot at the first executable open when its point-in-time strength clears remaining Satellite value plus normalized switching costs.
priorities: treat Satellites as short-horizon idle-capital fillers, not primary long-hold strategies
allow Satellites to enter only genuinely free capacity and cap each Satellite to one reference slot during Step 5B
preserve the ten-Core engine as the main opportunity source; Satellites never displace an already-open Core position
when a materially stronger new Core entry clears remaining Satellite value plus normalized costs/hysteresis, exit the weakest Satellite at the first executable open
favor positive realized after-cost filler PnL, short median/average hold, high profit per occupied hour and low Core-blocking time
calibrate router/filler horizon on training only; real-USDC holdout may reject but never retune
never use future realized PnL/MFE/MAE as decision inputs and never use fixed absolute-USDC switch thresholds
after Step 5B PASS, run Step 6 robustness before any final-five claim
research_fronts: idle-satellite five-market selection from current Binance Spot USDC markets
satellite handoff and forced-exit mechanics when core signals arrive
historical proxy research for mature assets whose USDC pair is newer, followed by real-USDC holdout validation
idle-capital secondary strategy with >=50 USDC tranches
hybrid slot routing and handoff priority
original basis-signal filtering for meaningful notional trades
success_rule: Step 5B passes only if a training-frozen short-horizon filler router and Satellite subset improve the same shared account versus Core-only under baseline and stress, do not increase Core NO_FREE_SLOT blocks, produce positive realized Satellite PnL, and then pass real-USDC holdout plus full-window rejection checks without retuning.

profit_concession.note: For the final satellite/router architecture, higher activity is not allowed to buy lower robust shared-account profit. Research diagnostics may explore trade-offs, but promotion requires non-regressive baseline and stress performance.

satellite_layer.core_reclaim_rule: A Satellite is a filler. A new Core entry may reclaim the weakest Satellite slot only when its point-in-time breakout/opportunity score exceeds the Satellite remaining-value score by normalized exit+entry costs plus the training-calibrated hysteresis. Weak Core signals do not preempt.
satellite_layer.handoff_semantics: first executable opportunity under the same closed-bar/order-timing semantics used by Backtest, Paper and Live; never assume impossible intrabar clairvoyance
satellite_layer.cross_quote_conversion_policy: Prefer direct USDC. Any USDT/other quote path must separately beat direct routing after conversion fees, spread, slippage, latency and failure-mode costs.
satellite_layer.selection_metric: incremental shared-portfolio net profit earned specifically during core-idle/free-slot periods after all trading costs, quote-conversion costs if any, and forced core-handoff losses
success_requires: shared portfolio baseline and stress return improve or satisfy the explicit activity architecture gate
materially superior opportunities are not missed because lower-value satellite exposure is held
routing decisions are point-in-time and scale-invariant
all costs and early-exit effects are normalized and fully modeled
real-USDC holdout and regional market availability pass
cross-window, shifted-3y, future-readiness and red-team pass

capital_state_machine.CAPACITY_IDLE: Validated satellites may deploy genuinely free capital.
capital_state_machine.SATELLITE_ACTIVE: Keep the satellite while its expected remaining normalized opportunity score is competitive with alternatives.
capital_state_machine.NEW_OPPORTUNITY_ARRIVES: Estimate a point-in-time normalized opportunity score for the candidate and the running position, including time horizon, uncertainty and costs.
capital_state_machine.SWITCH: If the candidate exceeds the running position by the validated cost/risk margin, exit or trim at the first executable opportunity and reallocate capital.
capital_state_machine.HOLD: If the candidate does not clear the normalized margin, keep the current position.
capital_state_machine.CAPACITY_IDLE_AGAIN: When capital becomes free again, satellite search resumes.

satellite_layer.target_example_only: Higher utilization and ending equity are desirable, but no historical result is a guarantee.
routing_units: expected net return percent on allocated capital
expected return per unit of risk
expected return per unit of time
satellite_layer.switch_formula: Switch when score(new_opportunity) - normalized_switch_cost - uncertainty_margin > score(current_position_remaining), where every score is normalized to the actual allocated capital and uses only information available at the decision time.
satellite_layer.position_size_scaling_rule: Any absolute USDC expectation shown to the user is derived dynamically from the chosen position size; routing decisions themselves must not depend on fixed absolute USDC profit/loss numbers.

capital_model.allocator_target: derive slot count, tranche sizes, reserve and reuse from C after validation
